notes: Grew from the original 58-example/7-class dataset (single repo) to 3731 examples across 10/10 classes and 4 repos.
extract_interface (8 examples) and simplify_condition (27 examples) remain thin - treat predictions for these classes with caution until more data is mined.

Two real bugs were found and fixed while scaling this: (1) build_refactoring_dataset.py opened mined JSON without UTF-8 encoding, crashing on non-ASCII content (FEBS-Cloud); (2) _git_checkout treated any non-zero exit from `git checkout --force` as failure, but on Windows this routinely happens for a handful of long-named (>260 char) test-fixture files even when the working tree otherwise switched correctly - fixed by verifying HEAD actually moved to the target commit instead of trusting the exit code. This alone recovered ~1500 additional matched examples from lisa.
